text:
Ava (CS): Quick heads-up — Greenleaf Payments (account: greenleaf-prod) just submitted a request to onboard a proprietary fraud scoring model. They need it in prod behind Private (VPC) or Dedicated, with strict data residency (EU), and no raw transaction logs leaving their environment. They want an initial evaluation and a safety checklist before we approve.

Daniel (Greenleaf): Thanks Ava. Confirming: model is TorchScript (.pt) exported from our training infra, ~4.3GB, expects JSON inputs like {"txn_id":..., "amount":..., "customer_meta":{...}}. We can provide a 10k-sample eval set with labels (fraud/not_fraud). No PHI but PII (emails, phone hashes) are present — we can hash/obfuscate if needed. Timeline: Q3 start, pilot for 2 weeks.

Ava (CS): Noted. Main asks from them: EU-only residency, private deployment, per-request PII hashing option, and an eval run to confirm FPR/FNR at their thresholds. They also asked about audit logs retention and who can access model artefacts.

Priya (Safety): @Daniel thanks — two quick clarifications: 1) Are there any free-text fields in the payload (notes, memos) that could contain sensitive content? 2) Do they have adversarial testcases (synthetic attempts) we should include in evals? We need to ensure no disclosure risk via model outputs.

Daniel (Greenleaf): 1) There is a short "memo" field (<=240 chars), mostly merchant notes. We can scrub or drop it for the eval exports. 2) We can add ~500 adversarial examples that mimic evasion patterns.

Marco (Platform): High-level onboarding plan: 
1) Security review (Priya) + legal sign-off for Private deployment.
2) Create a private model bundle in their EU VPC tenant. Manifest required: model name, framework, sha256, input schema, tokenization/serialization, and recommended quantization.
3) Eval run using our eval harness (cpu->gpu scoring) with provided labeled set + adversarial set. We'll produce ROC/AUC, precision@k, FPR@threshold.
4) If metrics pass and safety checks pass, schedule Dedicated slice or Private deployment.

Marco (Platform): Sample manifest they should provide (we'll accept this as model_metadata.json):
```
{
  "model_name": "greenleaf_fraud_v1",
  "format": "torchscript",
  "sha256": "<sha256-of-file>",
  "size_bytes": "4300000000",
  "input_schema": "{\"txn_id\":string, \"amount\":float, \"customer_meta\":object, \"memo\":string}",
  "recommended": {"quant": "int8-p4", "max_seq": 128},
  "privacy_notes": "memo field should be scrubbed; PII hashed before upload"
}
```

Priya (Safety): That manifest looks good. For the eval harness please add these acceptance criteria in the ticket: FPR < 0.5% at recall >= 85%, no generation of merchant PII in outputs, and no memos leaked in explanations. We also want a small red-team run for prompt injections.

Ava (CS): I'll capture those criteria in the CS ticket and confirm Greenleaf is okay with hashing PII. Daniel — can you confirm they can provide hashed customer identifiers and scrubbed memo field for the eval dataset?

Daniel (Greenleaf): Yes, we can provide hashed customer IDs (sha256) and will drop memo for the eval set. We'll upload to the secure EU S3 bucket you provide.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: CS-4122 — "Greenleaf fraud model onboarding (EU Private)" assigned to @Marco (Platform). Initial risk assessment requested.

Marco (Platform): Next steps for us: I'll spin up an eval job template and share instructions + bucket path by EOD. Priya — can you start the safety intake? Ava — I'll include the manifest template and the eval command in the ticket.

Priya (Safety): Starting intake now. ETA for first-pass review: 48 hours after we get the model bundle and eval data.

Ava (CS): Thanks all — I'll send Greenleaf the manifest template and the secure upload instructions, and I'll update the renewal/health tracker: greenleaf status -> onboarding requested, potential renewal uplift if pilot succeeds. :thumbsup:

Daniel (Greenleaf): Great, appreciate the quick turnaround. We'll aim to upload artifacts within 72 hours.

Ava (CS): Marking action items: 1) Daniel upload (72h) 2) Marco share eval template (EOD) 3) Priya start safety intake (48h after upload). I'll follow up in CS-4122.
